mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS poolId ,p.pool_name ,p.hs_pool_name FROM ip_investment_pool p WHERE p.is_deleted = 0 AND p.hs_pool_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.hs_pool_name) != '' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ip_investment_pool child WHERE child.parent_id = p.id AND child.is_deleted = 0) ORDER BY p.id ASC

SELECT si.short_name AS securityShortName ,si.wind_code_sh ,si.wind_code_sz ,si.wind_code_nib ,si.wind_code_bj ,si.wind_code_nbc ,al.adjust_reason FROM ip_pool_status ips INNER JOIN ip_investment_pool p ON p.id = ips.target_pool_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN rrs_securityinfo si ON si.wind_code = ips.security_code INNER JOIN dict_security_type dst ON dst.security_type = ips.security_type AND dst.is_deleted = 0 AND dst.category_type = 'bond' LEFT JOIN ip_adjust_log al ON al.id = ips.adjust_log_id AND al.is_deleted = 0 WHERE p.id = #{poolId} AND ips.is_deleted = 0 AND ips.audit_status = '20' AND ips.security_type != 'crmw' AND p.hs_pool_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.hs_pool_name) != '' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ip_investment_pool child WHERE child.parent_id = p.id AND child.is_deleted = 0) ORDER BY p.id ASC, si.wind_code ASC

SELECT DISTINCT si.short_name AS securityShortName ,si.wind_code_sh ,si.wind_code_sz ,si.wind_code_nib ,si.wind_code_bj ,si.wind_code_nbc ,current_al.adjust_reason FROM ip_adjust_log al INNER JOIN ip_pool_status ips ON ips.security_code = al.security_code AND ips.target_pool_id = al.target_pool_id AND ips.is_deleted = 0 AND ips.audit_status = '20' INNER JOIN ip_investment_pool p ON p.id = al.target_pool_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN rrs_securityinfo si ON si.wind_code = al.security_code INNER JOIN dict_security_type dst ON dst.security_type = ips.security_type AND dst.is_deleted = 0 AND dst.category_type = 'bond' LEFT JOIN ip_adjust_log current_al ON current_al.id = ips.adjust_log_id AND current_al.is_deleted = 0 WHERE p.id = #{poolId} AND al.is_deleted = 0 AND al.audit_status = '20' AND al.adjust_mode = '调入' AND al.audit_time > #{startTime} AND al.audit_time <= #{endTime} AND ips.security_type != 'crmw' AND p.hs_pool_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.hs_pool_name) != '' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ip_investment_pool child WHERE child.parent_id = p.id AND child.is_deleted = 0) ORDER BY p.id ASC, si.wind_code ASC
